title: Reload the unpacked development Extension
description: Development only: reload this unpacked Extension from its dist folder so a freshly built bundle replaces the running one. Advertised only by development builds and executes only for an unpacked (developer-mode) install.
guidance: Pass the engineRevision printed in dist/browser-engine-identity.json after the build: the call is a no-op when that revision already runs, refuses when the folder holds a different revision (build still writing or another build), and refuses while workflow executions or SidePanel Chat autonomous runs are active unless force is true. After status=reloading the reply is sent first, the Extension reloads after reloadDelayMs and the browser-hosted Native Agent restarts: expect EXTENSION_OFFLINE for a few seconds, then call again with the same expectedEngineRevision until status=already-current. Requires an idempotency key.

inputSchema.description: Which build must be running after the call.

expectedEngineRevision.description: engineRevision from dist/browser-engine-identity.json of the build that must be loaded.

force.description: Reload even while workflow executions or SidePanel Chat autonomous runs are active; their in-memory progress is lost. Defaults to false.

outputSchema.description: Reload decision for the running Extension.

status.description: reloading: this reply is sent first and the Extension reloads from disk after reloadDelayMs; already-current: the expected build is already running and nothing was reloaded.

runningEngineRevision.description: engineRevision of the bundle answering this call.

targetEngineRevision.description: engineRevision found in the dist folder; equals expectedEngineRevision when a reload was accepted.

extensionVersion.description: Manifest version of the bundle answering this call.

buildMode.description: Build mode recorded in the dist folder identity, for example pltest1; unknown when the identity file could not be read.

reloadDelayMs.description: Milliseconds between this reply and chrome.runtime.reload(); 0 when status is already-current.

offlineAhead.description: B24, with status=reloading only: the Extension and its browser-hosted Native Agent go offline right after this reply, on purpose. The Connector reads this envelope-level hint and answers the calls that fail meanwhile with businessCode EXTENSION_RELOADING and details.retryAfterMs instead of a bare offline: wait, back off, then dsagent_list_instances; nothing is lost.

reason.description: Why the browser goes offline: a reload of the Extension from disk.

expectedBackMs.description: How long the Extension expects to be offline, from this reply, before its runtime is back and dsagent_list_instances lists it again.

activeWork.description: Work that was running when the call was answered; non-zero with status=reloading only when force was true.

autonomousGoals.description: SidePanel Chat autonomous goals with an in-flight run.

guidedWizards.description: Guided wizards (dsagent.wizard.*) still guiding a session, possibly from another agent session.
